sceneConcept: A lean forty-three-year-old Chinese vehicle operations director walks briskly alone against a transparent background. His black hair is gelled into an immaculate side part, and half-lidded brown eyes accompany a small controlled smile that is courteous without warmth. He wears a precise charcoal blazer over an open-collar white dress shirt, straight black trousers, polished black shoes and a plain wristwatch. One dark blank tablet is firmly tucked beneath his arm as he meets the viewer mid-stride. Soft even frontal studio light creates no office, cars, dashboards, credit graphics, readable interface, company marks or bright rim.
